in_hebrew.name: קaleb
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קaleb הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'נאמן ה'', 'כוחו של ה''. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'ק' ו-'אל', שפירושם 'כל' ו'אלוקים', בהתאמה. השם קaleb מוזכר בתנ''ך כבן של יפונע, אחד מרגליו של משה, שנשלח לארץ כנען לסקר אותה. קaleb היה אחד משנים עשר הרגלים שקיבלו את השכר של האמונה והאומץ.

in_greek.name: Καλήβ
in_greek.meaning: πίστη του Θεού, δύναμις του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καλήβ είναι εβραϊκής προέλευσης και σημαίνει 'πίστη του Θεού', 'δύναμις του Θεού'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, δεν αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, αλλά η εβραϊκή μορφή του ονόματος Καλήβ (Kaleb) είναι γνωστή από την Παλαιά Διαθήκη. Ο Καλήβ ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα κατασκόπους που στάλθηκαν από τον Μωυσή για να εξετάσουν την γη Χαναάν.

in_latin.name: Kaleb
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kaleb origine hebraicum est et significat 'Fidelis Deo', 'Robur Dei'. In traditione christiana, nomen Kaleb habet significationem profundam spiritualem, quia exprimit fidem et fortitudinem in Deo. Kaleb fuit unus de duodecim exploratoribus, quos Moyses misit ad explorandam terram Chanaan.

in_english.name: Kaleb
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kaleb originates from Hebrew, meaning 'faithful to God' or 'God's power'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'kol' (all) and 'lev' (heart), or possibly from 'keleh' (slate or dog) and 'El' (God). Kaleb appears in the Bible as one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan. The name signifies spiritual loyalty, courage, and trust in God. Historically, Kaleb has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing faith and strength.

biblical_reference.note: Kaleb, son of Jephunneh, was one of the twelve spies sent to Canaan.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaleb, which originated from the Hebrew language, was given to a boy named Kaleb who was a mighty warrior in the Old Testament Scripture. He was remarkable for his faith, fierceness, and leadership in leading the Israelites to the Promised Land, leading them for 40 years. In this sense, the cultural impact of the name Kaleb signifies strength, courage, and resilience - traits that can inspire and motivate those named Kaleb, and indeed anyone who comes across the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kaleb can be traced back to its Hebrew root, where it translates to 'vineyard keeper.' This meaning evokes images of a nurturer, a caretaker, and a guardian. These are all qualities that mirror the role of Christians in living out their faith in the world - being stewards of God's creation and spreading the love and teachings of Jesus Christ to those around them.
